# GeometryScript

## `append_mesh_primitive`

Append a primitive shape to a DynamicMeshActor's dynamic mesh

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label or name of the target DynamicMeshActor |
| `primitive` | string | no | Box, Sphere, Cylinder, or Cone, default Box |
| `size` | number | no | Dominant dimension in cm, default 100 |
| `location` | array | no | Optional local [x, y, z] offset for the primitive |
| `dimensions` | number | no | Fallback alias for size when size is omitted (cm) |
| `material_id` | number | no | Optional MaterialID stamped on the appended triangles (default 0). Non-zero enables the mesh MaterialID attribute first, so a later copy_dynamic_mesh_to_static_mesh (bUseSectionMaterials=true) emits this piece as its own section/material slot. This is how one dynamic mesh becomes a multi-slot static mesh. |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name: string, primitive: string, size: number, material_id: int, triangle_count: int, triangles_added: int, vertex_count: int, appended: bool }`

## `append_mesh_to_dynamic_mesh`

Merge another UDynamicMesh into the live dynamic mesh of a DynamicMeshActor via UGeometryScriptLibrary_MeshBasicEditFunctions::AppendMesh.

## `apply_adaptive_remesh`

Adaptive-remesh a DynamicMeshActor's dynamic mesh using a target edge length and optional weight map

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label or name of the target DynamicMeshActor |
| `max_edge_length` | number | yes | Target edge length for adaptive remesh (sets TargetType=TargetEdgeLength + TargetEdgeLength). Required. |
| `min_edge_length` | number | no | Soft floor for adaptive edge length (default 1.0). NOTE: FGeometryScriptAdaptiveRemeshOptions has no explicit min field — this is echoed back in the result for traceability but is NOT consulted by the engine call. |
| `relative_density` | number | no | Density adjustment in [-2.0, 2.0] passed to FGeometryScriptAdaptiveRemeshOptions::RelativeDensity (default 0.0). |
| `weight_map_name` | string | no | Optional name of an existing vertex weight map (resolved via UGeometryScriptLibrary_MeshQueryFunctions::GetWeightMapHandle). If omitted or the mesh does not have such a layer, the engine runs adaptive remesh without a weight map (its default invalid handle). |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name: string, min_edge_length: number, max_edge_length: number, relative_density: number, weight_map_name: string, weight_map_resolved: bool, target_type: string, triangle_count: int, triangle_count_before: int, vertex_count: int, remeshed: bool }`

## `apply_mesh_boolean_actor_to_actor`

Apply a CSG boolean using a second DynamicMeshActor as the cutting tool. Unlike apply_mesh_boolean (which builds a transient primitive tool), the tool geometry is the live dynamic mesh of source_actor_name. The target mesh is mutated in place; the source mesh is left untouched. NOT idempotent: re-running keeps cutting/merging the same tool against the already-modified target.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label or name of the target DynamicMeshActor (the receiver, mutated in place) |
| `source_actor_name` | string | yes | Label or name of the DynamicMeshActor whose live dynamic mesh is used as the boolean tool |
| `operation` | string | no | Union, Subtract, or Intersect, default Subtract |
| `use_world_transforms` | boolean | no | Optional bool, default true. When true the tool is positioned by the relative world transform (source relative to target) so the boolean respects the actors' placement; when false the tool is applied at identity (co-located). |
| `fill_holes` | boolean | no | Optional bool override for FGeometryScriptMeshBooleanOptions.bFillHoles (default true) |
| `simplify_output` | boolean | no | Optional bool override for FGeometryScriptMeshBooleanOptions.bSimplifyOutput (default true) |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name: string, source_actor_name: string, operation: string, triangle_count: int, triangle_count_before: int, vertex_count: int, boolean_applied: bool }`

Apply an SDF-based morphology op (dilate/contract/close/open) to a DynamicMeshActor's dynamic mesh. Replaces the mesh with an SDF-based offset mesh approximation.

| `distance` | number | yes | Required positive float. Offset distance in cm (SDF-based). |

## `apply_mesh_solidify`

Voxel-wrap a DynamicMeshActor's dynamic mesh (replaces the mesh with a voxelised-and-meshed approximation).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label or name of the target DynamicMeshActor |
| `winding_threshold` | number | no | Optional [0..1], default 0.5. Space with generalised winding number above this is considered inside. |
| `extend_bounds` | number | no | Optional positive float, default 1.0. Bounds extension applied to the default input-mesh-based bounds. |
| `surface_search_steps` | number | no | Optional int >= 1, default 3. Marching-cubes vertex search steps. |
| `thicken_shells` | boolean | no | Optional bool, default false. Thicken open shells into closed solids (expensive on large meshes). |
| `shell_thickness` | number | no | Optional positive float, default 1.0. Offset distance for shell thickening. |

## `auto_generate_mesh_uvs`

Compute a real UV UNWRAP for the whole mesh via UGeometryScriptLibrary_MeshUVFunctions::AutoGeneratePatchBuilderMeshUVs or AutoGenerateXAtlasMeshUVs. This is what sits behind the editor's "Auto UV" button. Use it when a projection is not enough — organic or mixed-orientation geometry; for plank-and-post shapes set_mesh_uvs_from_projection with box is usually cleaner and far cheaper. Both methods PACK the result into standard UV space by default, so island layout is handled too. SLOW on dense meshes: this is a solver, not a projection.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label or name of the target DynamicMeshActor. |
| `method` | string | no | 'patch_builder' (default, the editor's Auto UV) or 'xatlas'. |
| `uv_channel` | number | no | UV channel to write (default 0). |
| `initial_patch_count` | number | no | patch_builder: how many patches to seed (default 100). More patches = less distortion, more seams. |
| `min_patch_size` | number | no | patch_builder: minimum triangles per patch (default 2). |
| `merging_threshold` | number | no | patch_builder: patch merging metric threshold (default 1.5). Higher merges more aggressively, giving fewer islands. |
| `max_angle_deg` | number | no | patch_builder: max angle in degrees between merged patches (default 45). |
| `respect_polygroups` | boolean | no | patch_builder: seed patches from the existing polygroups instead of curvature (default false). Useful right after append_mesh_primitive, where each appended face is already its own group. |
| `auto_pack` | boolean | no | Pack the resulting islands into standard UV space (default true). |
| `max_iterations` | number | no | xatlas: solver iterations (default 2). Higher is slower and slightly tighter. |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name, method, uv_channel, triangle_count: int, uv_channel_count: int, applied: bool }`

## `build_mesh_bvh`

Build a Bounding Volume Hierarchy for a DynamicMeshActor's dynamic mesh via UGeometryScriptLibrary_MeshSpatial::BuildBVHForMesh. The BVH is required for the spatial-query cmds (find_nearest_point_on_mesh, find_nearest_ray_intersection_with_mesh, is_point_inside_mesh). Idempotent: if b_only_if_invalid=true (default), a fresh BVH is built only when the existing one is invalid.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label or name of the target DynamicMeshActor. |
| `b_only_if_invalid` | boolean | no | Optional bool; defaults to true (skip rebuild if BVH is still valid). |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name, built: bool, bvh_valid: bool, vertex_count, triangle_count }`

## `copy_dynamic_mesh_to_static_mesh`

Write the live dynamic mesh of a DynamicMeshActor INTO an EXISTING /Game UStaticMesh asset's LOD via UGeometryScriptLibrary_StaticMeshFunctions::CopyMeshToStaticMesh (7-arg V2, bUseSectionMaterials=true; engine-default options). Editor-only (the engine function is WITH_EDITOR-gated and touches GEditor + FlushRenderingCommands). Idempotent: overwrites the target LOD in place, no duplication. HONEST GATES: the target asset must already exist (create it first, e.g. via create_editable_static_mesh) and must NOT live under /Engine/ (the engine refuses to modify built-in engine assets).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label or name of the source DynamicMeshActor. |
| `target_static_mesh_path` | string | yes | Content path of an EXISTING /Game UStaticMesh to overwrite. |
| `lod_index` | number | no | Optional target LOD index (default 0). Clamped by the engine to [0, MAX_STATIC_MESH_LODS]. |
| `materials` | array | no | Optional ordered list of UMaterialInterface content paths, one per MaterialID (index 0 = MaterialID 0). Supplying it flips bReplaceMaterials on, so the target asset gets exactly these material slots. WITHOUT this the asset keeps its existing slots and a multi-MaterialID mesh collapses into whatever slots already existed — this is the parameter that makes per-triangle MaterialIDs visible on the saved asset. |
| `material_slot_names` | array | no | Optional slot names matching materials 1:1 (default: the engine names them). Ignored when materials is absent. |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name, target_static_mesh_path, lod_index, outcome_success: bool, source_triangle_count, material_count: int, replaced_materials: bool, wrote: bool }. NOTE: this marks the target package dirty (transaction) but does NOT save to disk — persistence requires a separate save (e.g. via save_asset).`

## `copy_static_mesh_to_dynamic_mesh`

Copy the geometry of a UStaticMesh asset INTO the live dynamic mesh of a DynamicMeshActor via UGeometryScriptLibrary_StaticMeshFunctions::CopyMeshFromStaticMesh (engine-default options: build settings applied, tangents on). Destructive replace of the actor's current mesh. Idempotent-ish: re-running re-extracts the same source geometry (result depends only on the source asset + LOD). Reads the MaxAvailable LOD (LODIndex clamped to the asset's available LODs) so it is robust across meshes with fewer LODs.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source_static_mesh_path` | string | yes | Content path of the source UStaticMesh (e.g. "/Engine/BasicShapes/Cube"). |
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label or name of the target DynamicMeshActor whose GetDynamicMesh() receives the geometry. |
| `lod_index` | number | no | Optional source LOD index (default 0). LODType is MaxAvailable, so the index is silently clamped to the asset's LOD count. |

**Returns:** `{ source_static_mesh_path, actor_name, lod_index, outcome_success: bool, triangle_count, vertex_count, copied: bool }`

## `get_mesh_components_detail`

Enumerate the connected components (physical pieces) of a DynamicMeshActor's live dynamic mesh via UE::Geometry::FMeshConnectedComponents, reporting for EACH island its triangle count, its local-space bounding box, its triangle_id range and which MaterialIDs it carries. Read-only (unlike the engine's SplitMeshByComponents, which consumes the mesh). This is the map of a mesh in ONE call, and the tool to reach for BEFORE painting anything: get_mesh_material_ids says how many triangles carry each material, and this says what those triangles physically ARE. HONEST GATE: it names nothing — it gives you sizes and positions, and which island is which part is still a human call; what it prevents is deriving that from a triangle-count assumption.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label or name of the target DynamicMeshActor. |
| `max_components` | number | no | Cap on how many islands to return (default 64). components_truncated says whether the cap cut the list; component_count is always the real total. |
| `include_triangle_ids` | boolean | no | Also return each island's full triangle ID list (default false; use the reported id_min/id_max range instead unless the island is non-contiguous). |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name, component_count: int, components_truncated: bool, components: [ { index, triangle_count, id_min, id_max, id_contiguous: bool, material_ids: [int], bounds: { min_x, min_y, min_z, max_x, max_y, max_z, center_x, center_y, center_z, size_x, size_y, size_z }, triangle_ids: [int] } ] }`

## `get_mesh_material_ids`

Read the per-triangle MaterialID distribution of a DynamicMeshActor's live dynamic mesh via UGeometryScriptLibrary_MeshMaterialFunctions::GetMaxMaterialID + GetAllTriangleMaterialIDs. Read-only. This is the ORACLE for every MaterialID write: it returns a per-ID triangle histogram, so "did the paint actually land?" is answerable with a read instead of trusting a success flag. IMPORTANT: has_material_ids=false means the mesh has no MaterialID attribute at all, which is exactly the state in which writes are silently dropped by the engine.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label or name of the target DynamicMeshActor. |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name, has_material_ids: bool, max_material_id: int, triangle_count: int, distinct_material_ids: int, histogram: [ { material_id: int, triangle_count: int } ] }`

## `get_mesh_selection_bounds`

Resolve a region into a selection and report its local-space BOUNDING BOX via UGeometryScriptLibrary_MeshSelectionQueryFunctions::GetMeshSelectionBoundingBox. Read-only. Takes exactly the same region parameters as select_mesh_triangles and set_mesh_material_id_in_region, so a region measured here is the same one painted there. This is what turns a bisection answer ("the piece is somewhere in X>0") into actual numbers: centre and size, which is what lets you tell a 150x100x40 slab from a 14x230x75 rail without opening the editor.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label or name of the target DynamicMeshActor. |
| `region` | string | no | 'all' (default) \| 'box' \| 'sphere' \| 'plane' \| 'normal_angle' \| 'material_id' \| 'polygroup' \| 'connected_component'. |
| `component_index` | integer | no | Island index when region='connected_component'. Get it from get_mesh_components_detail, which reports each piece's size and bounding box. |
| `center` | array | no | Local [x,y,z] centre. Used by box/sphere, and as the plane origin. |
| `extent` | array | no | Local [x,y,z] HALF-size in cm. Required by region='box'. |
| `radius` | number | no | Radius in cm. Required by region='sphere'. |
| `normal` | array | no | [x,y,z] direction. Plane normal for region='plane', facing direction for 'normal_angle'. Default [0,0,1]. |
| `max_angle_deg` | number | no | Max angle from normal in degrees for region='normal_angle' (default 15). |
| `source_material_id` | integer | no | MaterialID to select when region='material_id'. |
| `polygroup_id` | integer | no | Polygroup to select when region='polygroup'. |
| `polygroup_layer` | integer | no | Optional extended polygroup layer index for region='polygroup'. |
| `min_triangle_points` | integer | no | How many of a triangle's 3 points must be inside for it to count, 1-3 (default 3). |
| `invert` | boolean | no | Invert the spatial selection (default false). |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name, region, triangles_selected: int, is_empty: bool, bounds: { min_x, min_y, min_z, max_x, max_y, max_z, center_x, center_y, center_z, size_x, size_y, size_z } }`

## `remap_material_ids`

Renumber MaterialIDs on a DynamicMeshActor's live dynamic mesh. Two modes: pass from_material_id + to_material_id to merge one ID into another (UGeometryScriptLibrary_MeshMaterialFunctions::RemapMaterialIDs), or pass compact=true with the material list to close gaps left by deleted/merged IDs (CompactMaterialIDs) and get back the compacted list to hand to copy_dynamic_mesh_to_static_mesh. Gaps matter: MaterialIDs index into that list positionally, so an unused ID in the middle costs a wasted material slot on the baked asset.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label or name of the target DynamicMeshActor. |
| `compact` | boolean | no | Compact mode: renumber IDs to be contiguous from 0 (default false). |
| `from_material_id` | number | no | Remap mode: the MaterialID to replace. Required unless compact is true. |
| `to_material_id` | number | no | Remap mode: the MaterialID to replace it with. Required unless compact is true. |
| `materials` | array | no | Compact mode: ordered UMaterialInterface content paths, one per current MaterialID. The compacted list is returned in compacted_materials, in the new ID order. |
| `remove_duplicate_materials` | boolean | no | Compact mode: also merge IDs that point at the SAME material asset (default false). |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name, mode: string, from_material_id: int, to_material_id: int, max_material_id_after: int, distinct_material_ids_after: int, compacted_materials: [string], applied: bool }`

|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label or object name (case-insensitive) of the DynamicMeshActor to destroy. |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name: string, actor_internal_name: string, destroyed: bool, triangle_count_before: int, note?: string }`

Remove the vertices no triangle references from a DynamicMeshActor's live dynamic mesh in the editor world and refresh its render data. Remaining vertex IDs are not renumbered and a clean mesh is a no-op; returns vertex_count_before, vertex_count, vertices_removed and removed.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label or object name (case-insensitive) of the target DynamicMeshActor in the editor world. |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name: string, triangle_count: int, vertex_count: int, vertex_count_before: int, vertices_removed: int, removed: bool }`

Pack existing UV islands on a UV channel into standard UV space.

| `uv_channel` | number | no | UV channel index (default 0) |
| `target_image_width` | number | no | target image width in pixels (default 512) |
| `optimize_island_rotation` | boolean | no | whether to optimize island rotation (default true) |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name, uv_channel, target_image_width, optimize_island_rotation, repacked }`

## `repair_mesh_self_intersections`

Boolean-union a DynamicMeshActor's dynamic mesh with itself to repair self-intersections, remove internal/floating geometry and resolve non-manifold overlaps (UGeometryScriptLibrary_MeshBooleanFunctions::ApplyMeshSelfUnion). Convergent: the first pass mutates the mesh, but a second pass on the already-cleaned mesh is a no-op (repaired reports false). NOTE: the engine impl ignores its internal success flag and always returns the target mesh, so success is measured by comparing the triangle count, not by the return value.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label or name of the target DynamicMeshActor (mutated in place) |
| `fill_holes` | boolean | no | Optional bool override for FGeometryScriptMeshSelfUnionOptions.bFillHoles (default true) |
| `trim_flaps` | boolean | no | Optional bool override for FGeometryScriptMeshSelfUnionOptions.bTrimFlaps (default true) |
| `simplify_output` | boolean | no | Optional bool override for FGeometryScriptMeshSelfUnionOptions.bSimplifyOutput (default true) |
| `winding_threshold` | number | no | Optional [0..1] float override for FGeometryScriptMeshSelfUnionOptions.WindingThreshold (default 0.5). Space with generalised winding number above this is considered inside. |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name: string, triangle_count: int, triangle_count_before: int, vertex_count: int, is_closed: bool, repaired: bool }`

Scale the live dynamic mesh of a DynamicMeshActor via UGeometryScriptLibrary_MeshTransformFunctions::ScaleMesh.

Scale all UVs of one channel on a DynamicMeshActor's live dynamic mesh in the editor world by separate U and V factors; zero factors are refused and 1, 1 changes nothing (scaled false). No undo entry; reply actor_name is the component name, not the actor label.

## `select_mesh_triangles`

Resolve a region into a triangle selection and REPORT it, without modifying anything. Read-only companion of set_mesh_material_id_in_region: same region parameters, same resolver, so a region previewed here paints exactly those triangles there. Use it to avoid the failure mode where a mis-specified box selects 0 triangles and the paint call still returns success. Coordinates are LOCAL to the dynamic mesh, not world.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label or name of the target DynamicMeshActor. |
| `region` | string | no | 'all' (default) \| 'box' \| 'sphere' \| 'plane' \| 'normal_angle' \| 'material_id' \| 'polygroup' \| 'connected_component' (one physical PIECE, by the island index that get_mesh_components_detail reports). |
| `center` | array | no | Local [x,y,z] centre. Used by box/sphere, and as the plane origin. |
| `extent` | array | no | Local [x,y,z] HALF-size in cm. Required by region='box'. |
| `radius` | number | no | Radius in cm. Required by region='sphere'. |
| `normal` | array | no | [x,y,z] direction. Plane normal for region='plane', facing direction for 'normal_angle'. Default [0,0,1]. |
| `max_angle_deg` | number | no | Max angle from normal in degrees for region='normal_angle' (default 15). |
| `source_material_id` | integer | no | MaterialID to select when region='material_id'. |
| `polygroup_id` | integer | no | Polygroup to select when region='polygroup'. |
| `polygroup_layer` | integer | no | Optional extended polygroup layer index for region='polygroup'. |
| `component_index` | integer | no | Island index when region='connected_component'. Get it from get_mesh_components_detail, which reports each piece's size and bounding box. |
| `min_triangle_points` | integer | no | How many of a triangle's 3 points must be inside for it to count, 1-3 (default 3 = fully contained). |
| `invert` | boolean | no | Invert the spatial selection (default false). |
| `include_triangle_ids` | boolean | no | Also return the resolved triangle IDs (default false; they can be thousands). The returned array is what set_mesh_material_id scope='triangles' consumes. |
| `max_triangle_ids` | number | no | Cap on how many IDs to return when include_triangle_ids is on (default 1000). When the cap truncates, triangle_ids_truncated is true — the count in triangles_selected is still the real one. |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name, region, triangles_selected: int, mesh_triangle_count: int, is_empty: bool, triangle_ids: [int], triangle_ids_truncated: bool }`

## `set_dynamic_mesh_material`

Assign a UMaterialInterface asset to a slot on a DynamicMeshActor's UDynamicMeshComponent.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label or name of the target DynamicMeshActor (required). |
| `material_path` | string | yes | Asset path of the UMaterialInterface (e.g. /Engine/EngineMaterials/DefaultMaterial) (required). |
| `slot_index` | number | no | Material slot to assign. Default 0 (the dynamic mesh only uses slot 0). |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name: string, material_path: string, material_name: string, slot_index: int, applied: bool, note?: string }`

## `set_mesh_material_id`

Stamp a MaterialID onto triangles of a DynamicMeshActor's live dynamic mesh. scope='all' repaints every triangle (UGeometryScriptLibrary_MeshMaterialFunctions::ClearMaterialIDs); scope='triangles' repaints the listed triangle IDs (SetMaterialIDOnTriangles). Calls EnableMaterialIDs first, because on a mesh without that attribute the engine drops the write and still reports success. Verify with get_mesh_material_ids, not with the success flag.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label or name of the target DynamicMeshActor. |
| `material_id` | number | no | MaterialID to write (>= 0). Index into the material list later passed to copy_dynamic_mesh_to_static_mesh. |
| `scope` | string | no | 'all' (default) or 'triangles'. |
| `triangle_ids` | array | no | Required when scope='triangles': array of triangle IDs to repaint (e.g. from select_mesh_triangles). |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name, material_id, scope, triangles_targeted: int, max_material_id_after: int, distinct_material_ids_after: int, applied: bool }`

## `set_mesh_material_id_in_region`

Stamp a MaterialID onto every triangle inside a region, via the engine's SelectMeshElements* family + SetMaterialIDForMeshSelection. Use this when polygroups are not usable — after a boolean, appended pieces are fused and set_polygroup_material_id cannot address them separately. Coordinates are LOCAL to the dynamic mesh, not world. Preview any region with select_mesh_triangles before painting: a region that selects 0 triangles still returns success.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label or name of the target DynamicMeshActor. |
| `material_id` | number | no | MaterialID to write (>= 0). |
| `region` | string | no | 'all' (default) \| 'box' \| 'sphere' \| 'plane' \| 'normal_angle' \| 'material_id' \| 'polygroup' \| 'connected_component' (one physical PIECE, by the island index that get_mesh_components_detail reports). |
| `center` | array | no | Local [x,y,z] centre. Used by box/sphere, and as the plane origin. |
| `extent` | array | no | Local [x,y,z] HALF-size in cm. Required by region='box'. |
| `radius` | number | no | Radius in cm. Required by region='sphere'. |
| `normal` | array | no | [x,y,z] direction. Plane normal for region='plane', facing direction for 'normal_angle'. Default [0,0,1]. |
| `max_angle_deg` | number | no | Max angle from normal in degrees for region='normal_angle' (default 15). |
| `source_material_id` | integer | no | The MaterialID to SELECT when region='material_id'. Separate from material_id, which is the one being written, so 'repaint 1 as 2' is expressible. |
| `polygroup_id` | integer | no | Polygroup to select when region='polygroup'. |
| `polygroup_layer` | integer | no | Optional extended polygroup layer index for region='polygroup'. |
| `component_index` | integer | no | Island index when region='connected_component'. Get it from get_mesh_components_detail, which reports each piece's size and bounding box. |
| `min_triangle_points` | integer | no | How many of a triangle's 3 points must be inside for it to count, 1-3 (default 3 = fully contained). Only used by the spatial regions. |
| `invert` | boolean | no | Invert the spatial selection (default false). |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name, material_id, region, triangles_selected: int, max_material_id_after: int, distinct_material_ids_after: int, applied: bool }`

## `set_mesh_uv_element_position`

Set the (u, v) of one element of a UV channel overlay on a DynamicMeshActor's live dynamic mesh in the editor world; an invalid element ID writes nothing and returns is_valid_element false, not an error. No undo entry; reply actor_name is the component name, not the actor label.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label or object name (case-insensitive) of the target DynamicMeshActor in the editor world. |
| `uv_channel` | number | yes | 0-based UV channel index; a channel the mesh does not have fails the call. |
| `element_id` | number | yes | ID of the element in the UV overlay of that channel, not a vertex, edge or triangle ID. |
| `u` | number | yes | New U coordinate of the element. |
| `v` | number | yes | New V coordinate of the element. |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name, uv_channel, element_id, new_position: {u, v}, is_valid_element, set: bool }`

## `set_mesh_uvs_from_projection`

Replace the UVs of one channel on a DynamicMeshActor's live dynamic mesh in the editor world with a box, plane or cylinder projection, optionally only inside a region. Box suits plank-and-post geometry (each face takes the axis it faces), plane only flat pieces, cylinder wrapped shapes. Returns triangles_affected and applied.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label or name of the target DynamicMeshActor. |
| `projection` | string | no | 'box' (default) \| 'plane' \| 'cylinder'. |
| `uv_channel` | number | no | UV channel to write (default 0). |
| `location` | array | no | Local [x,y,z] origin of the projection shape (default the mesh origin). |
| `rotation` | array | no | [pitch, yaw, roll] of the projection shape (default none). For 'plane', this is what chooses which way the plane faces. |
| `scale` | array | no | [x,y,z] size of the projection shape (default [100,100,100]). THIS IS THE UV DENSITY KNOB: bigger scale = texture repeats fewer times. A tileable material that reads too big or too small is fixed here, not in the material. |
| `min_island_tri_count` | number | no | box only: islands smaller than this are merged into a neighbour (default 2). |
| `split_angle` | number | no | cylinder only: angle in degrees at which the wrap is split (default 45). |
| `region` | string | no | Optional region to limit the projection to; same vocabulary as select_mesh_triangles (default 'all'). |
| `component_index` | integer | no | Island index when region='connected_component'. |
| `center` | array | no | Region parameter (box/sphere centre, plane origin). |
| `extent` | array | no | Region parameter: box HALF-size. |
| `radius` | number | no | Region parameter: sphere radius. |
| `normal` | array | no | Region parameter: plane/normal_angle direction. |
| `max_angle_deg` | number | no | Region parameter for region='normal_angle'. |
| `source_material_id` | integer | no | Region parameter for region='material_id'. |
| `polygroup_id` | integer | no | Region parameter for region='polygroup'. |
| `polygroup_layer` | integer | no | Region parameter for region='polygroup': extended polygroup layer index (default the mesh's default polygroup layer). |
| `min_triangle_points` | integer | no | Region parameter, 1-3. |
| `invert` | boolean | no | Select the complement of a box, sphere, plane or normal_angle region (default false); the other regions ignore it. |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name, projection, uv_channel, region, triangles_affected: int, uv_channel_count: int, applied: bool }`

## `set_num_extended_polygroup_layers`

Set the number of extended polygroup layers on the live dynamic mesh of a DynamicMeshActor via UGeometryScriptLibrary_MeshPolygroupFunctions::SetNumExtendedPolygroupLayers. Idempotent: the engine dedups (only reshapes attributes when the count actually differs from the current one), so re-setting the same count is a no-op. The layer count is read back AFTER the set via GetNumExtendedPolygroupLayers to confirm it landed.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label or name of the target DynamicMeshActor. |
| `num_layers` | number | no | Desired number of extended polygroup layers (>= 0). |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name, requested_num_layers, num_polygroup_layers, applied: bool }`

## `set_num_uv_channels`

Set the number of UV channels on a dynamic mesh.

| `actor_name` | string | yes | DynamicMeshActor name (required) |
| `num_uv_channels` | number | yes | Desired count (>= 0; &lt;= 8 in practice) (required) |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name: string, num_uv_channels: int, previous_num_uv_channels: int,`

## `set_polygroup_material_id`

Stamp a MaterialID onto every triangle of one polygroup via UGeometryScriptLibrary_MeshMaterialFunctions::SetPolygroupMaterialID. This is usually the cheapest way to paint a part: append_mesh_primitive lays primitives down with PerFace polygroups, so each appended piece is already its own group. HONEST GATE: the engine reports whether the polygroup ID actually existed, and that flag is surfaced as polygroup_id_valid — a false there means nothing was painted, even though the call succeeded.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label or name of the target DynamicMeshActor. |
| `polygroup_id` | number | no | Polygroup ID to repaint. |
| `material_id` | number | no | MaterialID to write (>= 0). |
| `polygroup_layer` | number | no | Optional extended polygroup layer index. Omit for the default layer. |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name, polygroup_id, material_id, polygroup_id_valid: bool, max_material_id_after: int, distinct_material_ids_after: int, applied: bool }`

QEM-simplify a DynamicMeshActor's dynamic mesh to a target triangle count

Apply a full FTransform (translation + rotation + scale) to the live dynamic mesh of a DynamicMeshActor via UGeometryScriptLibrary_MeshTransformFunctions::TransformMesh.

| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label or name of the target DynamicMeshActor |
| `location` | array | no | Optional [x, y, z] translation; default (0,0,0) |
| `rotation` | array | no | Optional [pitch, yaw, roll] rotation; default (0,0,0) |
| `scale` | array | no | Optional [x, y, z] scale; default (1,1,1) |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name, location:{}, rotation:{}, scale:{}, applied: true }`

## `translate_dynamic_mesh`

Translate the live dynamic mesh of a DynamicMeshActor via UGeometryScriptLibrary_MeshTransformFunctions::TranslateMesh.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label or name of the target DynamicMeshActor |
| `translation` | array | no | [x, y, z] translation delta in local space |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name, translation:{}, applied: true }`

## `translate_mesh_uvs`

Offset all UVs of one channel on a DynamicMeshActor's live dynamic mesh in the editor world by (translate_u, translate_v); a zero offset changes nothing (translated false). No undo entry; reply actor_name is the component name, not the actor label.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label or object name (case-insensitive) of the target DynamicMeshActor in the editor world. |
| `uv_channel` | number | yes | 0-based UV channel index; a channel the mesh does not have fails the call. |
| `translate_u` | number | yes | Offset added to every U coordinate (1.0 shifts by one full tile). |
| `translate_v` | number | yes | Offset added to every V coordinate (1.0 shifts by one full tile). |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name: string, uv_channel: int, translate_u: number, translate_v: number, translated: bool }`

## `weld_mesh_edges`

Weld coincident open boundary edges of a DynamicMeshActor's dynamic mesh

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label or name of the target DynamicMeshActor |
| `tolerance` | number | no | Coincident-edge distance threshold in mesh units (default 1e-06) |
| `only_unique_pairs` | boolean | no | Only merge unambiguous pairs with unique duplicate-edge matches (default true) |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name: string, tolerance: number, only_unique_pairs: bool, triangle_count: int, vertex_count: int, welded: bool }`
